questions.prompt: What was Derrick Rose's scoring average in his 2010–11 MVP season?
questions.note: 25.0 points per game alongside his playmaking.

funFacts.text: Rose also averaged 7.7 assists per game during his regular-season MVP campaign.
Rose recorded his first career triple-double against Memphis in January of that season.

source.quote: Derrick Rose also had his first career triple-double at the Memphis Grizzlies on Jan 17, 2011.

questions.prompt: How many career triple-doubles did Oscar Robertson record?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: For his career, Robertson had 181 triple-doubles, a record that had never been approached for decades

funFacts.text: Robertson played on the U.S. Olympic team in 1960 and later entered the Hall of Fame twice, including with that team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: having been inducted in 1980 for his individual career, and in 2010 as a member

funFacts.text: The Big O became the first guard to average double-digit rebounds per game, accomplishing it three times.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first guard in NBA history to ever average more than 10 rebounds per game

funFacts.text: Robertson finished his NBA career with Milwaukee, winning a championship alongside Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: For the first time in his career, Robertson had won an NBA championship
